No other commit touched the file since the verdict was stamped. The unit still feeds an EBGP UPDATE with MED 100 through notifyMessageReceiver with the med-10 import policy seam and requires exactly one dispatch carrying MED 10 in both RawBytes and WireUpdate.Payload. The existing single-polarity scope (alteration before the decision-process input boundary) is kept; TestRFC4271MEDAlterationHappensAtIngress is byte-identical. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
